hooks.command: uv run --quiet python -c "import json, re, sys; c = json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input', {}).get('command', ''); hit = re.search(r'\.env(?!\w)|secrets\.toml', c); hit and sys.stderr.write('Blocked: this command mentions .env or secrets.toml, which hold secrets.\n'); sys.exit(2 if hit else 0)"

uv run --quiet python -c "import json, subprocess, sys; p = json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', ''); sys.exit(subprocess.run(['ruff', 'format', '--quiet', p]).returncode if p.endswith('.py') else 0)"
